label: Required existential-production edges and their acyclicity
definition: There is no nonempty finite directed closed walk of required existential-production edges on the fixed mixed bearer/exercise carrier (Graph.NoCycles applied to RequiredEdge).
note: This is an analyst condition on the exercise data, without a requirement of well-foundedness. Justification for applying this condition to existential production remains open. See docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md.
